paper_abstract_as_shown: The last two decades have witnessed a growing trend towards transit-oriented development (TOD) as a critical approach for achieving sustainable mobility. However, some analysts and community activists have expressed concerns that TOD could induce gentrification and potential concomitant low-income group displacements. paper_abstract_as_shown: This dissertation consists of three chapters in labor and development economics. The first chapter analyzes the impacts of substantial increases in the Moroccan national minimum wage on gender gaps in employment and wages. Using matched employer-employee data along with detailed labor force surveys, I show that the minimum wage increases resulted in a significant narrowing of the gender pay gap in the formal manufacturing sector.
